[d0115] config | snapshotter.enabled | version 4.x
# `snapshotter.enabled`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `true` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | snapshotter |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `snapshotter.enabled` only if you observe problems with the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
enabled = true
```

---

[d0016] config | snapshotter.threshold_percent (PaderQueue 2.x) | version 2.x
# `snapshotter.threshold_percent` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Usage level in percent at which the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `75` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | % |

## Notes

Changes to `snapshotter.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
threshold_percent = 75
```

---

[d0192] changelog | PaderQueue 2.0 release notes | version 2.0
-letter queue.

- New option `snapshotter.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

- New error code PQ-E3321 (REPLICATOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `retention.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

- New option `scheduler.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time starts throttling.

- New error code PQ-E1451 (INGRESS_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.

- New option `snapshotter.batch_size`: number of messages the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues processes together in one batch.

- New error code PQ-E4895 (REPLICATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.

# `snapshotter.queue_capacity` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1000` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `snapshotter.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
queue_capacity = 1000
```
